questions.q: Which empire ruled the Ecuadorian highlands before the Spanish?
questions.why: Quito was a northern Inca capital.

questions.q: In which year did Ecuador become fully independent?
questions.why: It left Gran Colombia.

questions.q: Which 1822 battle on a volcano's slopes freed Quito?
questions.why: Antonio José de Sucre won it.

questions.q: Which naturalist visited the Galápagos in 1835?
questions.why: The visit shaped his theory of evolution.

questions.q: What currency did Ecuador adopt in 2000?
questions.why: It replaced the sucre.

questions.q: Which Inca emperor born near Quito fought his brother Huáscar?
questions.why: He was later captured by Pizarro.

questions.q: Which constitution of 2008 was the first to give rights to nature?
questions.why: It recognises 'Pacha Mama'.

questions.q: Which explorer measured the Earth near Quito in the 1730s?
questions.why: It proved the Earth bulges at the equator.

questions.q: Which heroine helped free Quito and fought with Bolívar?
questions.why: She saved Bolívar's life in 1828.

questions.q: Which colonial city in the south is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is famous for its blue domes.

questions.q: Which Ecuadorian city's old centre was among the first two UNESCO sites in 1978?
questions.why: Kraków was the other city.

questions.q: What is the capital of Ecuador?
questions.why: It is one of the world's highest capitals.

questions.q: Which islands inspired Darwin's theory of evolution?
questions.why: They are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which is Ecuador's largest city and main port?
questions.why: It is on the Guayas River.

questions.q: Which volcano near Quito is one of the highest active volcanoes?
questions.why: It is about 5,897 m high.

questions.q: Which monument near Quito marks the equator?
questions.why: Its name means 'middle of the world'.

questions.q: Which ocean lies west of Ecuador?
questions.why: The Galápagos are about 1,000 km offshore.

questions.q: Which mountain's summit is the farthest point from Earth's centre?
questions.why: The equatorial bulge makes it so.

questions.q: Which spa town sits at the foot of Tungurahua volcano?
questions.why: It is known for its hot springs and swings.

questions.q: Which Ecuadorian race walker won Olympic gold in 1996?
questions.why: It was Ecuador's first Olympic medal.

questions.q: Which Ecuadorian cyclist won Olympic road race gold in Tokyo?
questions.why: He also won the 2019 Giro d'Italia.

questions.q: Which President took the country left from 2007 to 2017?
questions.why: He wrote a new constitution in 2008.

questions.q: Which President took office in 2023 at age 35?
questions.why: He was re-elected in 2025.

questions.q: Which ancient culture made pottery in Ecuador over 5,000 years ago?
questions.why: It is one of the oldest in the Americas.

questions.q: Which Indigenous market town north of Quito is famous for crafts?
questions.why: Its Saturday market is huge.

questions.q: Which giant reptiles live on the Galápagos?
questions.why: Some live over 100 years.

questions.q: Which line gives Ecuador its name?
questions.why: 'Ecuador' is Spanish for equator.

questions.q: Which hat, made in Ecuador, is wrongly named after another country?
questions.why: It is woven from toquilla straw.

questions.q: Which fruit is Ecuador one of the world's largest exporters of?
questions.why: They grow on the coast.

questions.q: Which roasted rodent is a traditional Andean dish?
questions.why: It is eaten at celebrations.
